name: @tee-agent/contracts
description: Solidity contracts for the tee-agent (ERC-8004, ERC-7857)

scripts.deploy:local: yes | hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Deploy.ts --network localhost --reset
scripts.deploy:baseSepolia: yes | hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Deploy.ts --network baseSepolia --reset --verify --parameters ignition/parameters.baseSepolia.json && npm run setup-env:baseSepolia
scripts.deploy:base: yes | hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Deploy.ts --network base --reset --verify --parameters ignition/parameters.base.json
scripts.setOracle:baseSepolia: yes | node scripts/set-oracle.mjs baseSepolia && hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/SetOracle.ts --network baseSepolia --parameters ignition/parameters.baseSepolia.json
scripts.setOracle:base: yes | hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/SetOracle.ts --network base --parameters ignition/parameters.base.json
